nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
ERC20 token symbol string, set to 'KANYE' in the constructor.
ERC20 token name string, set to 'KANYE' in the constructor.
ERC20 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply storage variable, read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Adds two uints and requires c >= a to prevent overflow.
Subtracts b from a requiring b <= a to prevent underflow.
Multiplies two uints and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to prevent overflow.
Divides a by b requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing _newOwner into the pending newOwner slot.
Finalises ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves ownership and clears newOwner.
KANYE constructor setting symbol, name, decimals, total supply and pre-allocating all tokens to the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller's allowance using safeSub.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract transferring tokens to the owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization checks and balance/allowance indexing.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() which can underflow.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) enabling reentrancy/callback exploitation.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the owner state variable directly from msg.sender, giving deployer/caller control of ownership.
Owned constructor writes owner state variable from msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable and is gated by onlyOwner.
The _newOwner parameter is stored into the privileged newOwner slot.
The _newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before finalising the ownership handover.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token restricts the privileged sweep to msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is used as the key indexing the balances mapping in transfer/transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the first key indexing the allowed allowances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on the source balance and on the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)], which can underflow.
The unchecked subtraction consumes the _totalSupply state variable.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into spender.receiveApproval, allowing reentrant execution.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external callback into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller of the function.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
The spender parameter is the target address of the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
The user-supplied data parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call payload.
The tokenAddress parameter is the arbitrary external contract target of transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter of approveAndCall is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
safeAdd operand a flows into the guarded addition.
safeAdd operand b flows into the guarded addition.
safeSub operand a flows into the guarded subtraction.
safeSub operand b flows into the guarded subtraction.
safeMul operand a flows into the guarded multiplication.
safeMul operand b flows into the guarded multiplication.
safeDiv operand a flows into the guarded division.
safeDiv operand b flows into the guarded division.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient parameter 'to' drives the balance credit inside transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer via safeSub/safeAdd.
spender parameter becomes the key of the allowance entry written by approve.
tokens parameter becomes the allowance value written by approve.
from parameter indexes the source balance debited by transferFrom.
to parameter indexes the destination balance credited by transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
Return local c carries the checked sum produced by safeAdd.
Return local c carries the checked difference produced by safeSub.
Return local c carries the checked product produced by safeMul.
Return local c carries the checked quotient produced by safeDiv.
Return local balance holds the value read from the balances mapping.
Return local remaining holds the value read from the allowed mapping.
Return local success of transfer is set to true after the balance updates.
Return local success of approve is set to true after the allowance update.
Return local success of transferFrom is set to true after the balance updates.
Return local success of approveAndCall is set to true after the external call returns.
Return local success of transferAnyERC20Token forwards the external call result.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] to consume the spender allowance.
transfer writes updated balances for msg.sender and the recipient.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
KANYE constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
KANYE constructor pre-allocates the whole supply into balances of the deployer address.
